name: Theme icons
description: Font Awesome base icons, Material file and folder icons, and a configurable GTK icon theme for apps.

fields.title: Font Awesome shell icons
fields.description: Draw panel, launcher, settings and window icons from the bundled Font Awesome set.

fields.title: Base icon pack
fields.description: classic, duotone, sharp, sharp-duotone, chisel, etch, graphite, jelly, mosaic, notdog, pixel, slab, thumbprint, utility, vellum or whiteboard.

fields.title: Base icon style
fields.description: solid, regular, light or thin. Missing combinations fall back to the nearest available style.

fields.title: Icon theme name
fields.description: Installed theme directory name, for example Adwaita. Missing themes fall back to the session icon theme.

fields.title: Use the session icon theme
fields.description: Use the icon theme that was active before this extension started.

fields.title: Material file and folder icons
fields.description: Use bundled Material Icon Theme icons in Files, Quick Open and Editor tabs.
